# Ruflo AI

Updated: 2026-06-12
Canonical: https://ruflo.online/
Support: support@aigeamy.com

## Summary
Ruflo AI is a Hosted Ruflo multi-agent workspace for coding teams comparing Ruflo, Codex, Claude Code, and memory-backed agent workflows. It helps users get a hosted agent workflow with pricing, console tracking, memory, review loops, and setup evidence.

# Ruflo AI navigation reference

Ruflo AI helps teams plan, pay for, provision, and operate Ruflo workspaces with entrypoint choices, console access, and model-route context.

Canonical domain: https://ruflo.online/
Category: hosted Ruflo workspace and AI coding orchestration launch layer
Audience: coding teams, automation operators, and builders who want a repeatable Ruflo workspace instead of a one-off local setup
Pricing: Plans cover hosted workspace capacity, model-route setup, console access, and operational support for repeatable Ruflo work.
Support: support@aigeamy.com
Docs repository: https://github.com/clauxel/ruflo-online-docs
Upstream source context: Ruflo - https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo

Public navigation pages:
- Features: https://ruflo.online/features
- How It Works: https://ruflo.online/how-it-works
- Use Cases: https://ruflo.online/use-cases
- Guides: https://ruflo.online/guides
- Docs: https://ruflo.online/docs
- GitHub: https://ruflo.online/github
- Pricing: https://ruflo.online/plans

Important limits:
- Hosted Ruflo does not guarantee third-party model, repository, or credential provider availability.
- Teams remain responsible for code review and production decisions made from agent output.
- Custom enterprise infrastructure may still require a self-hosted or private deployment path.
- Ruflo AI is a hosted workspace layer around Ruflo-style workflows; the upstream open-source project remains separate.
